example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পেট ঢাকাইয়া হয়ে গেছে খাওয়ার পর।
example_sentences_in_english: His belly has become pot-bellied after eating.
This fruit has swollen up like a balloon.
history: Originates from the puffed-up appearance of traditional Dhaka fishing nets (ঢাকাই জাল), which resemble a swollen belly.
note: The idiom draws from the visual similarity to 'ঢাকাই জাল' (Dhaka-style net), a cultural reference to Dhaka's fishing heritage.
